full_judgment: 44. The learned Attorney-General relies upon the case of Habibur Rahman Mollah vs State. 62 DLR (AD) 233 which was also initiated under section 561 A In the above case the Appellate Division held as under :Whether the appellant has disproportionate wealth, whether he has concealed his known source of income, whether there is misjoinder of charges and whether the trial of the appellant on facts allegedly committed prior to the promulgation of Dumity Daman Commission Ain, 2004 constitute an offence under the Durnity Daman Commission Ain are disputed facts can only be decided on evidence at the trial."
